diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says SIG, datasheet reading says White (signal)
diffs.evidence: Same pin under a different label: the Luxorparts DS04-NFC datasheet lists connector position C as 'C - White (signal)', which is the model's SIG pin (whose description is the white wire carrying the 50 Hz control pulses), in the same Black(-)/Red(+)/White order as the model's GND/V+/SIG.
